page0.text:
"I'm not prepared to kill her. I came back here for Sakura.
"Ngh..."

page1.text:
"...Fine. I know where you stand.
You're saying you'll protect one person—Sakura—over everyone else."
"Yeah. I won't let you tell me that it's wrong. If you're going to hurt her, then I'll stop you here."

page2.text: "You'll stop me? No way. You can't even move a step, let alone try and stop me. No matter how much you want to protect Sakura, I won't let you go against my plan."

page3.text:
Tohsaka's voice is emotionless.
Then, I realize...
"Wh...at...?"
I can't even move a finger, let alone my limbs.

page4.text:
"Gurgh...!? Tohsaka, you...!"
"You said you wouldn't let me tell you that you're wrong. But you made a mistake. If you wanted to go your own way, you never should have given up your right to decide."

page5.text:
...
I feel my heart expand.
No, it's not my heart, but an oath binding it.

page6.text:
...Also,
for me, that was an ideal answer.
It's a little lacking, but this is all I need to do if that's your answer.

page8.text:
"Yeah. I only meant it as a joke, so I never thought it would come in handy. Once you swore absolute obedience to me, you lost the ability to defy my opinion.
Back there, you made a contract with me, not a promise. That means you're my servant, not my collaborator."

page9.text:
"Wha..."
"I'm going to kill Sakura. But don't get the wrong idea, Emiya. You wouldn't be able to stop me even if you didn't have this Geass on you.
This is my responsibility. It isn't your fault."

page10.text:
"Rrgh! Tohsaka, wai..."
I can't even finish my sentence anymore.

page11.text:
Tohsaka's gone.
"No...why..."
I can't move my body.

page12.text:
"Damn it! Are you kidding me!?"
I desperately try to move.
I need to get free.
I struggle to move as soon as I can, when suddenly,
my paralyzed body suddenly obeys me again.

page13.text:
"..."
My legs won't move to give chase.
I'm free, but my mind feels frozen.
Suddenly, I understand.
I won't be able to move my body as long as I go against Tohsaka's will.
Then...
If I can move freely again, that must mean my reason for opposing her is gone.

page14.text:
"Sakura..."
I drop to my knees.
With nowhere left to go, my heart breaks.

page15.text:
Light leaves my vision, and the church is covered in darkness.
Shirou Emiya is in zero gravity.
I swore that I'd abandon my past ideals to protect Sakura.
That was my new, unyielding guidepost.
And then, I lost it so quickly.

page16.text:
The war will go on.
The Holy Grail War will continue, and I'll probably fight alongside Tohsaka, who murdered Sakura, to end the conflict.

page17.text:
...But that will happen in a place that doesn't matter anymore.
Shirou Emiya has lost his place forever.
I'll keep going, without anything to guide me, not knowing what I should do...
